title: Ult Graves 3.2k-5.6k: Arcane Surge at 2.4k (damage first) or Grit/Duration Extender first?
question: Both orders hold 4.8k spirit at 5.6k. Arcane Surge first gives more spirit power when the ult unlocks; Grit/Extra Stamina first keep barrier and vitality bonus. Which wins the 3.2k-4k lane fight?
hypothesis: H-GU-2 (calc, council/triage/calc/graves_paths.txt): at 3.2k souls P0 (Arcane Surge first) has spirit power 65 (45 without the dash bonus) vs 37 and deals ~+22-30% damage per Hands+Jar+ult rotation; P2 (Grit first) has +200 barrier and +12% vitality bonus (~+30% effective HP).

arms.name: P0_surge_first
arms.notes: real tiers at 3.2k: Jar T1, Hands U, Theft U, Decree T2 (model A); record before each block

controls: Cooldowns and HP reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP and resists
procedure: Dash-jump, cast Decree on the enemy, then Hands, then Jar
Record damage dealt in 10s and your HP+barrier lost in the same 10s

decision.rule: SUPPORTS P0 if damage_10s >=15% higher and ehp_lost_pct not worse by more than 30%; REFUTES (switch to P2) if P2 is within 5% damage; else INCONCLUSIVE (keep P0 as the rule default: damage spike first).
